question.name: The Feast of Two Traditions
question.text: A converted Isolan family and a village family each offer to host a feast, but neither agrees on how it should be prepared.

a1.text: The meal becomes a new annual celebration.

a2.text: The cooks produce an astonishingly strange dish that tastes unexpectedly wonderful.

a3.text: The two head cooks quarrel, then discover their children have already eaten everything.

b1.text: Guests attend both and exchange stories late into the night.

b2.text: A scheduling mishap leaves both feasts short of cooks.

b3.text: The families decide that next year they will cook together.
